assessment_scope.source_boundary: Only the subject's five curated REVIEWED items at basis_commit, each read in full with its front matter: the canonical V1 MORE MORE JUMP! main-story synthesis (Japanese mmj_01_00-mmj_01_20 at the EVENT_0213 lock); the canonical EVENT_0005 and EVENT_0011 MMJ deep readings, each a discrete event envelope (EVENT_0011 with its cards and fifteen linked undated areas); and the canonical Generation 2 Hinomori Shizuku monograph and reconstruction model through EVENT_0222 at the PJSK_SOURCE_20261030T035133Z_EVENT_0222 lock, located by story, event, card, area and My SEKAI locators. Speech is the original-Japanese textual register; no performed voice or audiovisual analysis is admitted. Later event readings cited by the monograph (E0111, E0117, E0130, E0151, E0156, E0183, E0206, E0207, E0209, E0213), ledgers, the evidence index and Generation 1 files are not curated on this subject and no claim rests on them beyond what the curated items state. The package's R4 readiness label is project-local and was not adopted. No primary source was inspected.
assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: Shizuku from the friend-submitted application and her Cheerful＊Days history (recalled in the main story and EVENT_0011) through EVENT_0222. Default state: MMJ-EP-SZ-E0183 inheriting E0151, with E0111 choice support and E0156 craft teaching, within group E0213 after her center acceptance and before the unperformed semifinal. Earlier states are used at the located points: main-story MS-01 to 04 (she preserves MS-03 in phase P04, so Airi's attack and the repair are not one whole-phase state), EVENT_0005 (MMJ-EP-SZ-E0005), EVENT_0011 (MMJ-EP-SZ-E0011, which splits the managed-image resolve of chapters 1-6 from the self-presentation she chooses in chapter 7 and enacts in chapter 8), and the Generation 2 milestones (E0111, E0117, E0130, E0151, E0156, E0183, E0206, E0207, E0209, E0213); states between them rest on uncurated ledger snapshots. The Shiho My SEKAI exchange and the EVENT_0011 areas are undated. The boundary limits evidence, not knowledge: her former-group history and the main-story rupture belong to her at every later state.
assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit, applying the owner calibration rulings recorded there (B/C boundary, single counting of uncertainty, dialogue constrained-use test, chronology splits, relationship-transfer safeguards and control-state attribution); evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: The model states Hinomori Shizuku's aims (deliver hope, carry a chosen MORE MORE JUMP! (MMJ) task, use both professional histories, support another person's choice), pressures (fear of inadequacy, being reduced to appearance, competitive responsibility, concealed strain), five invariants, a seven-row conditional table and decision heuristics. Its central discriminator is that gentle affect is compatible with firm agency: the main-story synthesis and both event readings show the same soft register carrying refusal, a firm desire or an institutional exit, so content and actual response, not manner, decide the prediction. The items predict her mistakes and overreach: concealing hurt longer than is healthy (synthesis; model invariant 4), assenting to Minori's live-practice plan without voicing her fear and then blaming herself (EVENT_0011), overextension under freely chosen responsibility (E0151), confident but wrong navigation, gifts that reflect her taste more than the recipient's, and reading Shiho's explicit refusal as shyness. Not A: the package is compact, D3-D4 situations are abstained, and the items do not say what ends her concealment of hurt or which way she goes when curiosity meets a sibling's refusal. Not C: the items explain what changes her response when the recipient (Airi, Minori, Haruka, Arisa, Saito, Mafuyu, Shiho), stakes (an unwanted image, a rival's request, a center role), knowledge or chronology changes, and they say where that explanation stops.

The synthesis orders MMJ-SZ-MS-01 to 04 and says Shizuku preserves 03 in phase P04: a vocation that began with an application friends submitted, center visibility while colleagues discounted her labor, the wound of Airi's attack, then accountable repair and a chosen new partnership without return to Cheerful＊Days. EVENT_0005 keeps MS-04 and adds a personally voiced four-person preference (MMJ-EP-SZ-E0005). EVENT_0011 records an operative change (MMJ-EP-SZ-E0011) from preserving a managed flawless image to chosen present self-presentation, with its cause (the mixed live comments, Stage Luka's question, Airi's witness of her work). The monograph locates later changes with causes: E0111 choice support, E0117 recipient-defined presentation, E0130 stable intention across changing forms, E0151 chosen responsibility made legible through comparison with Hagiyama Yuu, E0156 craft teaching, E0183 integrated craft and consented rival help (the default state), E0206, E0207, and the E0213 center acceptance with acknowledged fear. Not A: states between the curated milestones rest on uncurated ledger snapshots, and E0117 and E0130 get one sentence each. Not C: transitions are explained, not only ordered, and the model says to select earlier self-presentation states rather than import current self-understanding.

The model gives five register rows with locators: 私, アリサちゃん, courteous requests and conditional reasoning with rivals at work (E0183), with direct technical feedback while accepting revision; 遥ちゃん, acknowledged anxiety and explicit first-person consideration in the E0213 choice; 朝比奈さん and invitation rather than demand to Mafuyu (E0207); しぃちゃん and an explicit decision to wait, when she discusses her sister with Stage Luka; a calm but mistaken quiz reading in public. The synthesis says her gentle phrasing can preserve work relations, oppose a harmful judgment, assert that she will not return or invite support, and that she permits dropping senior titles only after membership. EVENT_0005 says her hedges can accompany a question, an experiment or a firm desire, and EVENT_0011 records her accepting the address Luka-chan. Not B: the rows describe features and address forms more than observed wording, and there is no register row for Airi or Minori, her two closest partners, so output stays illustrative. Not D: register is conditioned by recipient, task and chronology with located forms.

Ordinary conduct is sampled across settings with conditions and failures: morning conditioning and the miso-soup thermos she offers when Minori spills water (EVENT_0011); enthusiasm for walking despite getting lost, difficulty with a tablet, and bringing soup while asking for help with unscripted talk (EVENT_0011 cards and areas); following Minori's instructions on the recording device and producing unintended inputs, then returning the group to filming, and finding an old Happy Everyday recording when Airi teaches her a search sequence (EVENT_0005 cards); suggesting rest when Minori is tired; dessert and an animal quiz with Airi; stretching practice with Minori; embroidery from remembered grandmother care (E0156); misnavigation, device help, excessive gift options and a birthday quiz-script mistake (monograph). The model's familiar-company row conditions these: warm invitation, personal gifts, aesthetic pleasure, asking for practical help and confident but mistaken navigation assumptions. Not A: school and family routines beyond the Shiho exchanges are thin. Not C: low-stakes behavior is conditioned by setting and recipient across several sources, including the mistakes.

Responses vary by relation and the items explain why. Airi carries the old ideal, the wound and accountable repair; her recognition matters without making every judgment right; in EVENT_0011 Airi alone hears all of Shizuku's walk confession and answers with her own admiration mixed with envy. Minori receives practical, preference-led help and can return valuable public insight; she also turns the camera on Shizuku's private practice before Shizuku is told. Haruka offers a consequential role whose reasons Shizuku evaluates, and in EVENT_0011 stops the group from choosing Shizuku's answer for her. Saito receives the E0111 choice-support method. Hagiyama Yuu is reciprocal commercial rivalry; Arisa is later co-work with unresolved resentment, and the model says not to collapse the two. Mafuyu receives accommodation of a limited disclosure without its whole cause. Shiho is loved and can refuse. Stage Luka receives the private account of the managed image. Not A: several relations rest on one event (Saito E0111, Yuu E0151, Mafuyu E0207), and transfer to an unsampled relation is lower confidence. Not C: the items say what changes her response from recipient to recipient.

Located private states with causes: longing for trustworthy collaboration and hurt concealed under composed work conduct (synthesis); the counterfactual that continued modeling might have made her more useful in the agency search, and the specific desire she reaches when Airi asks what she wants (EVENT_0005 card); her private resolve to preserve the flawless image after overhearing students, her unspoken fear of exposing the unedited self, self-blame after the mixed comments, fear of disappointing recognizable passersby, and her account to Stage Luka of childhood expectation and worry about burdening MMJ (EVENT_0011); former intensity as fear and preparation (E0151); acknowledged fear in the E0213 center decision. The model links these states to choices and warns that composure can protect a task while private hurt remains. Not A: interior access is through text and self-report, and the later-era states are summarized briefly. Not C: the items explain from within why she refused editing, why she left the old institution and why she accepted the center role.

Located cases with conditions: on the rooftop she refuses Airi's negation of Minori's dream and invokes Airi's own norm that an idol cannot abandon an aspiring child (synthesis); she does not return to the group that mistreated her; when Haruka and Airi consider an edited format she asks to make her own decision, then refuses Haruka's offered editing (EVENT_0011); with rivals she withdraws after refusal and offers renewed help only with MMJ's permission and a conditional diagnosis, then accepts the performers' revisions (E0183); in a public former-group encounter composure protects the immediate task while private hurt remains; with Shiho she can wait or can overinterpret reluctance. The model's rows separate these contexts and its heuristic says to read the content of a gentle reply, not its manner. Not A: sustained adversarial institutions are D3, her response to later criticism is open (EVENT_0011), and the items leave open whether she waits or presses when her sister refuses. Not C: the conflict routes are conditioned by recipient, prior refusal and group cost.

Her own located reasoning: support should widen another person's sustainable options and return the choice (E0111, model invariant 3); a prior refusal is not authorization, and shared group time needs its own permission before rival help (E0183); kinship does not authorize entering Shiho's important feelings, so she decides to wait for willing explanation (monograph); she distinguishes choosing a responsibility for MMJ from being made to bear the group alone (E0151); she refuses to let an edited image stand in for her present self (EVENT_0011). Countercases: in an undated My SEKAI exchange she reads Shiho's explicit refusal as shyness, and freely chosen responsibility overextends her (E0151). The rehearsal camera in EVENT_0011 is the others' decision, not hers. Not B: the items state the consent principle and show it failing in her own family relation without saying what decides which way she goes, and they give no rule that weighs chosen responsibility against her own health. Not D: positions are located with reasons.

Play-adjacent conduct is located but sparse: she addresses the phone playfully during the recording mishap, while the laughter at it belongs to Airi and Haruka (EVENT_0005); she shares dessert and jokes with Airi over an animal quiz and accepts Stage Luka's invitation to the address Luka-chan (EVENT_0011); the monograph records a birthday quiz-script mistake and a literal response to exaggerated fan distress, which it treats as an interpretive limit. Not C: the items give no account of what she finds funny or when she starts play, and most comic moments are unintended. Not E: the instances are located across three items with recipients.

The curated set covers the complete MMJ main-story foundation (21 files, 1,891 records at its lock), two complete early event envelopes (EVENT_0005; EVENT_0011, her own focal event, with cards and fifteen linked areas) and the Generation 2 package through EVENT_0222 with event, card, area and My SEKAI locators. Not B: the package is about 17.7 KB for a long live-service corpus, the later event readings it cites (E0111, E0117, E0130, E0151, E0156, E0183, E0206, E0207, E0209, E0213) and the ledgers are not curated on this subject, and performed voice is not analysed. Not D: coverage is located across the main story, two early events and later milestones.

Affirmative limits and contradictions are explicit. The model lists failure modes to avoid: passive beauty, saintly omniscience, general incompetence, universal forgiveness and gentle speech as consent; chosen intensity does not prove safe intensity. Former-member reconciliation is absent (synthesis), Arisa's resentment persists and Shizuku does not receive every private jealous thought (monograph). She is not shown agreeing before the camera turns to her rehearsal, does not demonstrate MC mastery, and the rumor she overheard is not verified history (EVENT_0011, EVENT_0005). Device difficulty does not certify general incompetence. She knows Mafuyu's limited disclosure and that Shiho has a world, not their causes or history. A favorable comment majority does not prove that public vulnerability is always safe. Not A: the abstentions are stated as distances, not as a complete table. Not C: these are located affirmative limits, not inferences from silence.

Claims carry story, event, card, area and My SEKAI locators (for example 08/002:0006-0019, C132a/002:0002-0049, PJSK:event:0011:07:003:0014-0042, PJSK:event:0213:08:001:0068-0089). State IDs (MMJ-SZ-MS-04, MMJ-EP-SZ-E0005, MMJ-EP-SZ-E0011, MMJ-EP-SZ-E0183) and the default state are named, EVENT_0011 orders its three streams and card scenes, and the items flag which areas and My SEKAI exchanges are undated. Not A: the Shiho My SEKAI exchange and the EVENT_0011 areas cannot be dated, and states between milestones are uncurated. Not C: located states and chronology constraints are explicit.

conditions: Written Japanese register only, as illustration, never quotation; no claim about breath, pitch, timing or vocal softness.
Use the located forms for the located recipients (アリサちゃん, 遥ちゃん, 朝比奈さん, しぃちゃん, Luka-chan) and honor the chronology of title permissions: senior titles are dropped only after membership.
Soft phrasing may carry refusal, correction, a firm desire or a competitive claim; generate content first, then register.
Lines to Airi or Minori rest on the functional descriptions, not on a register row, and are lower confidence.
scenario_readiness.note: Written illustrative lines are constrained by located address forms and the functions of her gentle phrasing. Not READY: the rows give features more than wording, and no row covers Airi or Minori. Not NOT_READY: recipient forms and register functions are located.

conditions: Select her state (main-story MS-03 or MS-04, EVENT_0005, EVENT_0011, or the E0183 default inheriting E0151 within group E0213), the recipient and any prior refusal before predicting a choice.

When a rival or unfamiliar collaborator asks for help (D2), keep a conditional offer, withdrawal, narrowed scope or continued own work visible depending on refusal, competence and group cost; do not force reconciliation.
Under freely chosen responsibility she may overextend; an available offer of care does not guarantee pacing.
When her curiosity or care meets a sibling's or close person's refusal, present both waiting and overinterpreting the refusal as available, and let the other person's actual refusal stand.
Transfer to an unsampled relationship of a comparable kind (a similar known recipient or teaching task, D1) is a separate, lower-confidence condition.

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: The default state: MMJ-EP-SZ-E0183 inheriting E0151, with E0111 choice support and E0156 craft teaching, within group E0213 through EVENT_0222, the center role accepted and the semifinal unperformed; or a located earlier state with its own knowledge (main-story MS-03 or MS-04, EVENT_0005, EVENT_0011). She knows Mafuyu's limited disclosure and that Shiho has a world, not their causes or private history, and Arisa's reader-visible interior is not hers.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: MORE MORE JUMP! members (Airi, Minori, Haruka), Arisa and the other former Cheerful＊Days performers as rivals in work, Hagiyama Yuu, Saito, Mafuyu, Shiho, Stage Luka, Rin and Miku, and an audience as located recipients; transfer to an unsampled relationship is a separate, lower-confidence condition.
setting_constraints: Represented idol work, live streams and public image, consented craft exchange, family affection and choice support (D0), or a similar known recipient or teaching task (D1), or an unfamiliar rival collaboration with plural outcomes kept visible (D2).
No sustained adversarial institution or unrepresented media crisis (D3), no novel danger or intimacy (D4), and no semifinal or career outcome.
Textual Japanese register only; no performed voice.

scenario_readiness.note: Bounded transfer is supported by the conditional table, the manner-versus-content discriminator, state-specific knowledge and recipient contrasts. Not READY: the package is compact and the sibling-boundary fork and the end of concealed hurt are unresolved. Not NOT_READY: matched help, rivalry, presentation and choice-support cases are explained.

conditions: Familiar company: warm invitation, personal gifts, aesthetic pleasure, affectionate interest and requests for practical help.
Include her ordinary limits: confident but mistaken navigation, device difficulty and gift choices that reflect her taste; received help supplies a capacity without removing the limitation.
School, parents and strangers outside the located scenes are lower confidence.
scenario_readiness.note: Ordinary scenes are sampled with their failures. Not READY: school and family routines are thin. Not NOT_READY: familiar-company behavior is conditioned across several sources.

conditions: Ground output in her located positions: support returns the choice, a prior refusal is not authorization, shared group time needs permission, and chosen responsibility differs from being made to bear a group alone.
Where her care or curiosity meets another person's refusal, present both branches rather than one resolution.
Decisions others made about her, such as the EVENT_0011 rehearsal camera, are not her ethics.
scenario_readiness.note: Located positions support bounded use. Not READY: no rule weighs her care or curiosity against another's refusal, or chosen responsibility against her own health. Not NOT_READY: the choice-support and permission positions are located with reasons.
No curated item analyses romantic attachment for Shizuku. This records absent evidence, not an inability.

conditions: Professional challenge: inspect footage, recognize another's force and choose greater responsibility; intensity may exceed good pacing despite available care.
Public presentation follows her EVENT_0011 choice to show effort and mistakes as she is; an earlier scenario uses the earlier managed-image state.
She accepts a role on her own evaluation of its reasons, not merely because someone asked; do not depict the semifinal or its outcome.
scenario_readiness.note: Idol work is the best-sampled domain. Not READY: the center performance and later career outcomes are unknown, and pacing is unsafe under chosen stakes. Not NOT_READY: training, presentation, rival assistance and role choice are explained.

known_limits.statement: Composure is not an index of her state: she can preserve work relations or protect a task while privately hurt, and in EVENT_0011 she assented to a plan without voicing her fear. The items do not say what ends that concealment.
With Shiho she can recognize a limit and wait, yet also read an explicit refusal as shyness; the items model the refusal, not which branch she takes.
Freely chosen responsibility can overextend her (E0151 lost sleep and concern); success does not show that the intensity is necessary or safe.
Former-group repair is absent or incomplete: she did not return to Cheerful＊Days, Arisa's co-work keeps unresolved resentment, and other members' stances stay distinct.

She knows Mafuyu's limited disclosure and that Shiho has a world, not their causes or history; her private account to Stage Luka is not the group's knowledge; she was not told before the rehearsal camera turned to her.
The E0213 center performance, durable audience reception and later career outcomes are not depicted at the boundary.
The later event readings the monograph cites and the ledgers are not curated on this subject; states between the curated milestones are not assessed from them.
No performed voice, singing or audiovisual analysis is admitted; speech is textual register only.
No curated item analyses romantic attachment.
Sustained adversarial institutions, unrepresented media crises (D3) and novel danger or intimacy (D4) are outside the evidence.
